prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: Use AGM003165329 SG225 as group candidate: no printed path negatives, force0 and .052 GPa fine stress. SG166 sibling has only tiny first-row x0 acoustic negatives but BFGS failure; SG123 sibling has fine force .0506 and .793 GPa stress. Both remain separate source variants, not extra candidate counts. Binary primary Mo-Tc ground-state opposition limits claim to local metastable research phase.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Source coarse force 0.0 eV/Å, pressure 0.002 GPa; fine force 0.0 eV/Å, pressure -0.052000000000000005 GPa. Actual full stress, Γ interval, finite path and q observations are retained in the complete review; no whole-BZ/global-stability claim.

counterevidence.scope: Coupling and separate source-model Tc move in opposite directions against this alternative; a monotonic coupling-to-Tc explanation is insufficient.

proposed_contribution.intervention: Re-to-Tc and W-to-Mo ordered role construction in Mo3Tc. coupled chemistry/site-role/volume/mass construction, not isolated geometry or inferred W/n
proposed_contribution.next_action: Compare retained exact SG225 Mo3Tc and Mo3Re orbital/mode evidence, then bounded phase competition. Favorable: local source pairing advantage and plausible metastable phase remain; adverse: decomposition/ordering competition eliminates object; ambiguous: no formation relation. Do not select a sibling merely by its Tc.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
